entries.name: ACCSystemCharges
entries.docstring: A system of charges, specified by the number of charges.
entries.snippet:
structure ACCSystemCharges where
  numberCharges : ℕ

entries.name: ACCSystemChargesMk
entries.docstring: Creates an `ACCSystemCharges` object with the specified number of charges.
entries.snippet: def ACCSystemChargesMk (n : ℕ) : ACCSystemCharges where

entries.name: ACCSystemCharges.Charges
entries.docstring: The charges as functions from `Fin χ.numberCharges → ℚ`.
entries.snippet: def Charges (χ : ACCSystemCharges) : Type

entries.name: ACCSystemCharges.chargesAddCommMonoid
entries.docstring:
An instance to provide the necessary operations and properties for `charges` to form an additive
  commutative monoid.
entries.snippet:
@[simps!]
instance chargesAddCommMonoid (χ : ACCSystemCharges) : AddCommMonoid χ.Charges

entries.name: ACCSystemCharges.chargesModule
entries.docstring:
An instance to provide the necessary operations and properties for `charges` to form a module
  over the field `ℚ`.
entries.snippet:
@[simps!]
instance chargesModule (χ : ACCSystemCharges) : Module ℚ χ.Charges

entries.name: ACCSystemLinear
entries.docstring: The type of charges plus the linear ACCs.
entries.snippet:
structure ACCSystemLinear extends ACCSystemCharges where
  numberLinear : ℕ
  linearACCs : Fin numberLinear → (toACCSystemCharges.Charges →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)

entries.name: ACCSystemLinear.LinSols
entries.docstring: The type of solutions to the linear ACCs.
entries.snippet:
structure LinSols (χ : ACCSystemLinear) where
  val : χ.1.Charges
  linearSol : ∀ i : Fin χ.numberLinear, χ.linearACCs i val = 0

entries.name: ACCSystemLinear.LinSols.ext
entries.docstring: Two solutions are equal if the underlying charges are equal.
entries.snippet:
@[ext]
lemma LinSols.ext {χ : ACCSystemLinear} {S T : χ.LinSols} (h : S.val = T.val) : S = T

entries.name: ACCSystemQuad
entries.docstring: The type of charges plus the linear ACCs plus the quadratic ACCs.
entries.snippet:
structure ACCSystemQuad extends ACCSystemLinear where
  numberQuadratic : ℕ
  quadraticACCs : Fin numberQuadratic → HomogeneousQuadratic toACCSystemCharges.Charges

entries.name: ACCSystemQuad.QuadSols
entries.docstring: The type of solutions to the linear and quadratic ACCs.
entries.snippet:
structure QuadSols (χ : ACCSystemQuad) extends χ.LinSols where
  quadSol : ∀ i : Fin χ.numberQuadratic, (χ.quadraticACCs i) val = 0

entries.name: ACCSystem
entries.docstring: The type of charges plus the anomaly cancellation conditions.
entries.snippet:
structure ACCSystem extends ACCSystemQuad where
  cubicACC : HomogeneousCubic toACCSystemCharges.Charges

entries.name: ACCSystem.Sols
entries.docstring: The type of solutions to the anomaly cancellation conditions.
entries.snippet:
structure Sols (χ : ACCSystem) extends χ.QuadSols where
  cubicSol : χ.cubicACC val = 0

entries.name: SM.SMNoGrav.One.E_zero_iff_Q_zero
entries.snippet:
lemma E_zero_iff_Q_zero {S : (SMNoGrav 1).Sols} : Q S.val (0 : Fin 1) = 0 ↔
    E S.val (0 : Fin 1) = 0

entries.name: SM.SMNoGrav.One.accGrav_Q_zero
entries.snippet:
lemma accGrav_Q_zero {S : (SMNoGrav 1).Sols} (hQ : Q S.val (0 : Fin 1) = 0) :

entries.name: SM.SMNoGrav.One.accGrav_Q_neq_zero
entries.snippet:
lemma accGrav_Q_neq_zero {S : (SMNoGrav 1).Sols} (hQ : Q S.val (0 : Fin 1) ≠ 0)
    (FLTThree : FermatLastTheoremWith ℚ 3) :

entries.name: SM.SMNoGrav.One.accGravSatisfied
entries.docstring: Any solution to the ACCs without gravity satisfies the gravitational ACC.
entries.snippet:
theorem accGravSatisfied {S : (SMNoGrav 1).Sols} (FLTThree : FermatLastTheoremWith ℚ 3) :
    accGrav S.val = 0

entries.name: GeorgiGlashow.GaugeGroupI
entries.snippet:
informal_definition GaugeGroupI where
  math :≈ "The group `SU(5)`."
  physics :≈ "The gauge group of the Georgi-Glashow model."

entries.name: GeorgiGlashow.inclSM
entries.snippet:
informal_definition inclSM where
  physics :≈ "The homomorphism of the Standard Model gauge group into the
    Georgi-Glashow gauge group."
  math :≈ "The group homomorphism `SU(3) x SU(2) x U(1) -> SU(5)`
    taking (h, g, α) to (blockdiag (α ^ 3 g, α ^ (-2) h)."
  ref :≈ "Page 34 of https://math.ucr.edu/home/baez/guts.pdf"
  deps :≈ [``GaugeGroupI, ``StandardModel.GaugeGroupI]

entries.name: GeorgiGlashow.inclSM_ker
entries.snippet:
informal_lemma inclSM_ker where
  math :≈ "The kernel of the map ``inclSM is equal to the subgroup
    ``StandardModel.gaugeGroupℤ₆SubGroup."
  ref :≈ "Page 34 of https://math.ucr.edu/home/baez/guts.pdf"
  deps :≈ [``inclSM, ``StandardModel.gaugeGroupℤ₆SubGroup]

entries.name: GeorgiGlashow.embedSMℤ₆
entries.snippet:
informal_definition embedSMℤ₆ where
  math :≈ "The group embedding from ``StandardModel.GaugeGroupℤ₆ to ``GaugeGroupI
    induced by ``inclSM by quotienting by the kernal ``inclSM_ker."
  deps :≈ [``inclSM, ``StandardModel.GaugeGroupℤ₆, ``GaugeGroupI, ``inclSM_ker]

entries.name: PatiSalam.GaugeGroupI
entries.snippet:
informal_definition GaugeGroupI where
  math :≈ "The group `SU(4) x SU(2) x SU(2)`."
  physics :≈ "The gauge group of the Pati-Salam model (unquotiented by ℤ₂)."

entries.name: PatiSalam.inclSM
entries.snippet:
informal_definition inclSM where
  physics :≈ "The homomorphism of the Standard Model gauge group into the Pati-Salam gauge group."
  math :≈ "The group homomorphism `SU(3) x SU(2) x U(1) -> SU(4) x SU(2) x SU(2)`
    taking (h, g, α) to (blockdiag (α h, α ^ (-3)), g, diag(α ^ (3), α ^(-3)))."
  ref :≈ "Page 54 of https://math.ucr.edu/home/baez/guts.pdf"
  deps :≈ [``GaugeGroupI, ``StandardModel.GaugeGroupI]

entries.name: PatiSalam.inclSM_ker
entries.snippet:
informal_lemma inclSM_ker where
  math :≈ "The kernel of the map ``inclSM is equal to the subgroup
    ``StandardModel.gaugeGroupℤ₃SubGroup."
  ref :≈ "Footnote 10 of https://arxiv.org/pdf/2201.07245"
  deps :≈ [``inclSM, ``StandardModel.gaugeGroupℤ₃SubGroup]

entries.name: PatiSalam.embedSMℤ₃
entries.snippet:
informal_definition embedSMℤ₃ where
  math :≈ "The group embedding from ``StandardModel.GaugeGroupℤ₃ to ``GaugeGroupI
    induced by ``inclSM by quotienting by the kernal ``inclSM_ker."
  deps :≈ [``inclSM, ``StandardModel.GaugeGroupℤ₃, ``GaugeGroupI, ``inclSM_ker]

entries.name: PatiSalam.gaugeGroupISpinEquiv
entries.snippet:
informal_definition gaugeGroupISpinEquiv where
  math :≈ "The equivalence between `GaugeGroupI` and `Spin(6) × Spin(4)`."
  deps :≈ [``GaugeGroupI]

entries.name: PatiSalam.gaugeGroupℤ₂SubGroup
entries.snippet:
informal_definition gaugeGroupℤ₂SubGroup where
  physics :≈ "The ℤ₂-subgroup of the un-quotiented gauge group which acts trivially on
    all particles in the standard model."
  math :≈ "The ℤ₂-subgroup of ``GaugeGroupI with the non-trivial element (-1, -1, -1)."
  ref :≈ "https://math.ucr.edu/home/baez/guts.pdf"
  deps :≈ [``GaugeGroupI]

entries.name: PatiSalam.GaugeGroupℤ₂
entries.snippet:
informal_definition GaugeGroupℤ₂ where
  physics :≈ "The gauge group of the Pati-Salam model with a ℤ₂ quotient."
  math :≈ "The quotient of ``GaugeGroupI by the ℤ₂-subgroup `gaugeGroupℤ₂SubGroup`."
  ref :≈ "https://math.ucr.edu/home/baez/guts.pdf"
  deps :≈ [``GaugeGroupI, ``gaugeGroupℤ₂SubGroup]

entries.name: PatiSalam.sm_ℤ₆_factor_through_gaugeGroupℤ₂SubGroup
entries.snippet:
informal_lemma sm_ℤ₆_factor_through_gaugeGroupℤ₂SubGroup where
  math :≈ "The group ``StandardModel.gaugeGroupℤ₆SubGroup under the homomorphism ``embedSM factors
    through the subgroup ``gaugeGroupℤ₂SubGroup."
  deps :≈ [``inclSM, ``StandardModel.gaugeGroupℤ₆SubGroup, ``gaugeGroupℤ₂SubGroup]

entries.name: PatiSalam.embedSMℤ₆Toℤ₂
entries.snippet:
informal_definition embedSMℤ₆Toℤ₂ where
  math :≈ "The group homomorphism from ``StandardModel.GaugeGroupℤ₆ to ``GaugeGroupℤ₂
    induced by ``embedSM."
  deps :≈ [``inclSM, ``StandardModel.GaugeGroupℤ₆, ``GaugeGroupℤ₂,
    ``sm_ℤ₆_factor_through_gaugeGroupℤ₂SubGroup]

entries.name: Spin10Model.GaugeGroupI
entries.snippet:
informal_definition GaugeGroupI where
  math :≈ "The group `Spin(10)`."
  physics :≈ "The gauge group of the Spin(10) model (aka SO(10)-model.)"

entries.name: Spin10Model.inclPatiSalam
entries.snippet:
informal_definition inclPatiSalam where
  physics :≈ "The inclusion of the Pati-Salam gauge group into Spin(10)."
  math :≈ "The lift of the embedding `SO(6) x SO(4) → SO(10)` to universal covers,
    giving a homomorphism `Spin(6) x Spin(4) → Spin(10)`. Precomposed with the isomorphism,
    ``PatiSalam.gaugeGroupISpinEquiv, between `SU(4) x SU(2) x SU(2)` and `Spin(6) x Spin(4)`."
  ref :≈ "Page 56 of https://math.ucr.edu/home/baez/guts.pdf"
  deps :≈ [``GaugeGroupI, ``PatiSalam.GaugeGroupI, ``PatiSalam.gaugeGroupISpinEquiv]

entries.name: Spin10Model.inclSM
entries.snippet:
informal_definition inclSM where
  physics :≈ "The inclusion of the Standard Model gauge group into Spin(10)."
  math :≈ "The compoisiton of ``embedPatiSalam and ``PatiSalam.inclSM."
  ref :≈ "Page 56 of https://math.ucr.edu/home/baez/guts.pdf"
  deps :≈ [``inclPatiSalam, ``PatiSalam.inclSM]

entries.name: Spin10Model.inclGeorgiGlashow
entries.snippet:
informal_definition inclGeorgiGlashow where
  physics :≈ "The inclusion of the Georgi-Glashow gauge group into Spin(10)."
  math :≈ "The Lie group homomorphism from SU(n) → Spin(2n) dicussed on page 46 of
    https://math.ucr.edu/home/baez/guts.pdf for n = 5."
  deps :≈ [``GaugeGroupI, ``GeorgiGlashow.GaugeGroupI]

entries.name: Spin10Model.inclSMThruGeorgiGlashow
entries.snippet:
informal_definition inclSMThruGeorgiGlashow where
  physics :≈ "The inclusion of the Standard Model gauge group into Spin(10)."
  math :≈ "The composition of ``inclGeorgiGlashow and ``GeorgiGlashow.inclSM."
  deps :≈ [``inclGeorgiGlashow, ``GeorgiGlashow.inclSM]

entries.name: Spin10Model.inclSM_eq_inclSMThruGeorgiGlashow
entries.snippet:
informal_lemma inclSM_eq_inclSMThruGeorgiGlashow where
  math :≈ "The inclusion ``inclSM is equal to the inclusion ``inclSMThruGeorgiGlashow."
  deps :≈ [``inclSM, ``inclSMThruGeorgiGlashow]

entries.name: TwoHDM.Potential
entries.docstring: The parameters of the Two Higgs doublet model potential.
entries.snippet:
structure Potential where
  m₁₁2 : ℝ
  m₂₂2 : ℝ
  m₁₂2 : ℂ
  𝓵₁ : ℝ
  𝓵₂ : ℝ
  𝓵₃ : ℝ
  𝓵₄ : ℝ
  𝓵₅ : ℂ
  𝓵₆ : ℂ
  𝓵₇ : ℂ

entries.name: TwoHDM.Potential.toFun
entries.docstring: The potential of the two Higgs doublet model.
entries.snippet: def toFun (Φ1 Φ2 : HiggsField) (x : SpaceTime) : ℝ

entries.name: TwoHDM.Potential.zero
entries.docstring: The potential where all parameters are zero.
entries.snippet: def zero : Potential

entries.name: TwoHDM.Potential.swap_fields
entries.snippet:
lemma swap_fields : P.toFun Φ1 Φ2 =
    (Potential.mk P.m₂₂2 P.m₁₁2 (conj P.m₁₂2) P.𝓵₂ P.𝓵₁ P.𝓵₃ P.𝓵₄
    (conj P.𝓵₅) (conj P.𝓵₇) (conj P.𝓵₆)).toFun Φ2 Φ1

entries.name: TwoHDM.Potential.right_zero
entries.docstring: If `Φ₂` is zero the potential reduces to the Higgs potential on `Φ₁`.
entries.snippet:
lemma right_zero : P.toFun Φ1 0 =
    (HiggsField.Potential.mk (- P.m₁₁2) (P.𝓵₁/2)).toFun Φ1

entries.name: TwoHDM.Potential.left_zero
entries.docstring: If `Φ₁` is zero the potential reduces to the Higgs potential on `Φ₂`.
entries.snippet:
lemma left_zero : P.toFun 0 Φ2 =
    (HiggsField.Potential.mk (- P.m₂₂2) (P.𝓵₂/2)).toFun Φ2

entries.name: TwoHDM.Potential.neg_left
entries.docstring: Negating `Φ₁` is equivalent to negating `m₁₂2`, `𝓵₆` and `𝓵₇`.
entries.snippet:
lemma neg_left : P.toFun (- Φ1) Φ2
    = (Potential.mk P.m₁₁2 P.m₂₂2 (- P.m₁₂2) P.𝓵₁ P.𝓵₂ P.𝓵₃ P.𝓵₄ P.𝓵₅ (- P.𝓵₆) (- P.𝓵₇)).toFun
    Φ1 Φ2

entries.name: TwoHDM.Potential.neg_right
entries.docstring: Negating `Φ₁` is equivalent to negating `m₁₂2`, `𝓵₆` and `𝓵₇`.
entries.snippet:
lemma neg_right : P.toFun Φ1 (- Φ2)
    = (Potential.mk P.m₁₁2 P.m₂₂2 (- P.m₁₂2) P.𝓵₁ P.𝓵₂ P.𝓵₃ P.𝓵₄ P.𝓵₅ (- P.𝓵₆) (- P.𝓵₇)).toFun
    Φ1 Φ2

entries.name: TwoHDM.Potential.left_eq_right
entries.snippet:
lemma left_eq_right : P.toFun Φ1 Φ1 =
    (HiggsField.Potential.mk (- P.m₁₁2 - P.m₂₂2 + 2 * P.m₁₂2.re)
    (P.𝓵₁/2 + P.𝓵₂/2 + P.𝓵₃ + P.𝓵₄ + P.𝓵₅.re + 2 * P.𝓵₆.re + 2 * P.𝓵₇.re)).toFun Φ1

entries.name: TwoHDM.Potential.left_eq_neg_right
entries.snippet:
lemma left_eq_neg_right : P.toFun Φ1 (- Φ1) =
    (HiggsField.Potential.mk (- P.m₁₁2 - P.m₂₂2 - 2 * P.m₁₂2.re)
    (P.𝓵₁/2 + P.𝓵₂/2 + P.𝓵₃ + P.𝓵₄ + P.𝓵₅.re - 2 * P.𝓵₆.re - 2 * P.𝓵₇.re)).toFun Φ1

entries.name: TwoHDM.Potential.IsBounded
entries.docstring: The proposition on the coefficents for a potential to be bounded.
entries.snippet: def IsBounded : Prop

entries.name: TwoHDM.Potential.isBounded_right_zero
entries.snippet:
lemma isBounded_right_zero (h : P.IsBounded) :

entries.name: TwoHDM.Potential.isBounded_left_zero
entries.snippet:
lemma isBounded_left_zero (h : P.IsBounded) :
    (HiggsField.Potential.mk (- P.m₂₂2) (P.𝓵₂/2)).IsBounded

entries.name: TwoHDM.Potential.isBounded_𝓵₁_nonneg
entries.snippet:
lemma isBounded_𝓵₁_nonneg (h : P.IsBounded) :

entries.name: TwoHDM.Potential.isBounded_𝓵₂_nonneg
entries.snippet:
lemma isBounded_𝓵₂_nonneg (h : P.IsBounded) :
    0 ≤ P.𝓵₂

entries.name: TwoHDM.Potential.isBounded_of_left_eq_right
entries.snippet:
lemma isBounded_of_left_eq_right (h : P.IsBounded) :
    0 ≤ P.𝓵₁/2 + P.𝓵₂/2 + P.𝓵₃ + P.𝓵₄ + P.𝓵₅.re + 2 * P.𝓵₆.re + 2 * P.𝓵₇.re

entries.name: TwoHDM.Potential.isBounded_of_left_eq_neg_right
entries.snippet:
lemma isBounded_of_left_eq_neg_right (h : P.IsBounded) :
    0 ≤ P.𝓵₁/2 + P.𝓵₂/2 + P.𝓵₃ + P.𝓵₄ + P.𝓵₅.re - 2 * P.𝓵₆.re - 2 * P.𝓵₇.re

entries.name: TwoHDM.Potential.nonneg_sum_𝓵₁_to_𝓵₅_of_isBounded
entries.snippet:
lemma nonneg_sum_𝓵₁_to_𝓵₅_of_isBounded (h : P.IsBounded) :
    0 ≤ P.𝓵₁/2 + P.𝓵₂/2 + P.𝓵₃ + P.𝓵₄ + P.𝓵₅.re

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeGroupI
entries.docstring:
The global gauge group of the Standard Model with no discrete quotients.
  The `I` in the Name is an indication of the statement that this has no discrete quotients.
entries.snippet: abbrev GaugeGroupI : Type

entries.name: StandardModel.gaugeGroupℤ₆SubGroup
entries.snippet:
informal_definition gaugeGroupℤ₆SubGroup where
  physics :≈ "The subgroup of the un-quotiented gauge group which acts trivially on
    all particles in the standard model. "
  math :≈ "The ℤ₆-subgroup of ``GaugeGroupI with elements (α^2 * I₃, α^(-3) * I₂, α), where `α`
    is a sixth complex root of unity."
  ref :≈ "https://math.ucr.edu/home/baez/guts.pdf"
  deps :≈ [``GaugeGroupI]

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeGroupℤ₆
entries.snippet:
informal_definition GaugeGroupℤ₆ where
  physics :≈ "The smallest possible gauge group of the Standard Model."
  math :≈ "The quotient of ``GaugeGroupI by the ℤ₆-subgroup `gaugeGroupℤ₆SubGroup`."
  ref :≈ "https://math.ucr.edu/home/baez/guts.pdf"
  deps :≈ [``GaugeGroupI, ``StandardModel.gaugeGroupℤ₆SubGroup]

entries.name: StandardModel.gaugeGroupℤ₂SubGroup
entries.snippet:
informal_definition gaugeGroupℤ₂SubGroup where
  physics :≈ "The ℤ₂subgroup of the un-quotiented gauge group which acts trivially on
    all particles in the standard model. "
  math :≈ "The ℤ₂-subgroup of ``GaugeGroupI derived from the ℤ₂ subgroup of `gaugeGroupℤ₆SubGroup`."
  ref :≈ "https://math.ucr.edu/home/baez/guts.pdf"
  deps :≈ [``GaugeGroupI, ``StandardModel.gaugeGroupℤ₆SubGroup]

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeGroupℤ₂
entries.snippet:

  ref :≈ "https://math.ucr.edu/home/baez/guts.pdf"
  deps :≈ [``GaugeGroupI, ``StandardModel.gaugeGroupℤ₂SubGroup]

entries.name: StandardModel.gaugeGroupℤ₃SubGroup

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeGroupQuot
entries.docstring:
Specifies the allowed quotients of `SU(3) x SU(2) x U(1)` which give a valid
  gauge group of the Standard Model.
entries.snippet:
inductive GaugeGroupQuot : Type
  | ℤ₆ : GaugeGroupQuot
  | ℤ₂ : GaugeGroupQuot
  | ℤ₃ : GaugeGroupQuot
  | I : GaugeGroupQuot

entries.name: StandardModel.gaugeGroupI_lie
entries.snippet:
informal_lemma gaugeGroupI_lie where
  math :≈ "The gauge group `GaugeGroupI` is a Lie group.."
  deps :≈ [``GaugeGroupI]

entries.name: StandardModel.gaugeGroup_lie
entries.snippet:
informal_lemma gaugeGroup_lie where
  math :≈ "For every q in ``GaugeGroupQuot the group ``GaugeGroup q is a Lie group."
  deps :≈ [``GaugeGroup]

entries.name: StandardModel.gaugeBundleI
entries.snippet:
informal_definition gaugeBundleI where
  math :≈ "The trivial principal bundle over SpaceTime with structure group ``GaugeGroupI."
  deps :≈ [``GaugeGroupI, ``SpaceTime]

entries.name: StandardModel.gaugeTransformI
entries.snippet:
informal_definition gaugeTransformI where
  math :≈ "A global section of ``gaugeBundleI."
  deps :≈ [``gaugeBundleI]

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsVec.ofReal
entries.docstring:
Generating a Higgs vector from a real number, such that the norm-squared of that Higgs vector
  is the given real number.
entries.snippet: def ofReal (a : ℝ) : HiggsVec

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsVec.ofReal_normSq
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma ofReal_normSq {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) : ‖ofReal a‖ ^ 2 = a

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsVec.toField_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma HiggsVec.toField_apply (φ : HiggsVec) (x : SpaceTime) : (φ.toField x) = φ

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsField.ofReal
entries.docstring:
Generating a constant Higgs field from a real number, such that the norm-squared of that Higgs
  vector is the given real number.
entries.snippet: def ofReal (a : ℝ) : HiggsField

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsField.zero
entries.docstring: The higgs field which is all zero.
entries.snippet: def zero : HiggsField

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsField.zero_is_zero_section
entries.snippet:
informal_lemma zero_is_zero_section where
  physics :≈ "The zero Higgs field is the zero section of the Higgs bundle."
  math :≈ "The HiggsField `zero` defined by `ofReal 0`
    is the constant zero-section of the bundle `HiggsBundle`."
  deps :≈ [`StandardModel.HiggsField.zero]

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsVec.rotate_fst_real_snd_zero
entries.snippet:
theorem rotate_fst_real_snd_zero (φ : HiggsVec) :
    ∃ (g : GaugeGroupI), rep g φ = ![Complex.ofReal ‖φ‖, 0]

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsVec.guage_orbit
entries.snippet:
informal_lemma guage_orbit where
  math :≈ "There exists a `g` in ``GaugeGroupI such that `rep g φ = φ'` if and only if
    ‖φ‖ = ‖φ'‖."
  deps :≈ [``rotate_fst_zero_snd_real]

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsVec.stability_group_single
entries.snippet:
informal_lemma stability_group_single where
  physics :≈ "The Higgs boson breaks electroweak symmetry down to the electromagnetic force."
  math :≈ "The stablity group of the action of `rep` on `![0, Complex.ofReal ‖φ‖]`,
    for non-zero `‖φ‖` is the `SU(3) x U(1)` subgroup of
    `gaugeGroup := SU(3) x SU(2) x U(1)` with the embedding given by
    `(g, e^{i θ}) ↦ (g, diag (e ^ {3 * i θ}, e ^ {- 3 * i θ}), e^{i θ})`."
  deps :≈ [``StandardModel.HiggsVec, ``StandardModel.HiggsVec.rep]

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsVec.stability_group
entries.snippet:
informal_lemma stability_group where
  math :≈ "The subgroup of `gaugeGroup := SU(3) x SU(2) x U(1)` which preserves every `HiggsVec`
    by the action of ``StandardModel.HiggsVec.rep is given by `SU(3) x ℤ₆` where ℤ₆
    is the subgroup of `SU(2) x U(1)` with elements `(α^(-3) * I₂, α)` where
    α is a sixth root of unity."
  deps :≈ [``HiggsVec, ``rep]

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsField.gaugeAction
entries.snippet:
informal_definition gaugeAction where
  math :≈ "The action of ``gaugeTransformI on ``HiggsField acting pointwise through
    ``HiggsVec.rep."
  deps :≈ [``HiggsVec.rep, ``gaugeTransformI]

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsField.guage_orbit
entries.snippet:
informal_lemma guage_orbit where
  math :≈ "There exists a `g` in ``gaugeTransformI such that `gaugeAction g φ = φ'` if and only if
    φ(x)^† φ(x) = φ'(x)^† φ'(x)."
  deps :≈ [``gaugeAction]

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsField.gauge_orbit_surject
entries.snippet:
informal_lemma gauge_orbit_surject where
  math :≈ "For every smooth map f from ``SpaceTime to ℝ such that `f` is positive semidefinite,
    there exists a Higgs field φ such that `f = φ^† φ`."
  deps :≈ [``HiggsField, ``SpaceTime]

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsField.innerProd_neg_left
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma innerProd_neg_left (φ1 φ2 : HiggsField) : ⟪- φ1, φ2⟫_H = -⟪φ1, φ2⟫_H

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsField.innerProd_neg_right
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma innerProd_neg_right (φ1 φ2 : HiggsField) : ⟪φ1, - φ2⟫_H = -⟪φ1, φ2⟫_H

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsField.normSq_apply_im_zero
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma normSq_apply_im_zero (φ : HiggsField) (x : SpaceTime) :
    ((Complex.ofReal' ‖φ x‖) ^ 2).im = 0

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsField.normSq_apply_re_self
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma normSq_apply_re_self (φ : HiggsField) (x : SpaceTime) :
    ((Complex.ofReal' ‖φ x‖) ^ 2).re = φ.normSq x

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsField.ofReal_normSq
entries.snippet: lemma ofReal_normSq {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (x : SpaceTime) : (ofReal a).normSq x = a

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsField.Potential
entries.docstring: The parameters of the Higgs potential.
entries.snippet:
structure Potential where
  μ2 : ℝ
  𝓵 : ℝ

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsField.Potential.toFun
entries.docstring: The function corresponding to the Higgs potential.
entries.snippet: def toFun (φ : HiggsField) (x : SpaceTime) : ℝ

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsField.Potential.toFun_smooth
entries.docstring: The potential is smooth.
entries.snippet:
lemma toFun_smooth (φ : HiggsField) :
    Smooth 𝓘(ℝ, SpaceTime) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) (fun x => P.toFun φ x)

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsField.Potential.neg
entries.docstring: The Higgs potential formed by negating the mass squared and the quartic coupling.
entries.snippet: def neg : Potential where

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsField.Potential.toFun_neg
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma toFun_neg (φ : HiggsField) (x : SpaceTime) : P.neg.toFun φ x = - P.toFun φ x

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsField.Potential.μ2_neg
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma μ2_neg : P.neg.μ2 = - P.μ2

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsField.Potential.𝓵_neg
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma 𝓵_neg : P.neg.𝓵 = - P.𝓵

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsField.Potential.toFun_zero
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma toFun_zero (x : SpaceTime) : P.toFun HiggsField.zero x = 0

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsField.Potential.complete_square
entries.snippet:
lemma complete_square (h : P.𝓵 ≠ 0) (φ : HiggsField) (x : SpaceTime) :
    P.toFun φ x = P.𝓵 * (‖φ‖_H ^ 2 x - P.μ2 / (2 * P.𝓵)) ^ 2 - P.μ2 ^ 2 / (4 * P.𝓵)

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsField.Potential.as_quad
entries.snippet:
lemma as_quad (φ : HiggsField) (x : SpaceTime) :
    P.𝓵 * ‖φ‖_H ^ 2 x * ‖φ‖_H ^ 2 x + (- P.μ2) * ‖φ‖_H ^ 2 x + (- P.toFun φ x) = 0

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsField.Potential.toFun_eq_zero_iff
entries.snippet:
lemma toFun_eq_zero_iff (h : P.𝓵 ≠ 0) (φ : HiggsField) (x : SpaceTime) :
    P.toFun φ x = 0 ↔ φ x = 0 ∨ ‖φ‖_H ^ 2 x = P.μ2 / P.𝓵

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsField.Potential.quadDiscrim
entries.docstring: The discrimiant of the quadratic equation formed by the Higgs potential.
entries.snippet: def quadDiscrim (φ : HiggsField) (x : SpaceTime) : ℝ

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsField.Potential.quadDiscrim_nonneg
entries.docstring: The discriminant of the quadratic formed by the potential is non-negative.
entries.snippet:
lemma quadDiscrim_nonneg (h : P.𝓵 ≠ 0) (φ : HiggsField) (x : SpaceTime) :
    0 ≤ P.quadDiscrim φ x

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsField.Potential.quadDiscrim_eq_sqrt_mul_sqrt
entries.snippet:
lemma quadDiscrim_eq_sqrt_mul_sqrt (h : P.𝓵 ≠ 0) (φ : HiggsField) (x : SpaceTime) :
    P.quadDiscrim φ x = Real.sqrt (P.quadDiscrim φ x) * Real.sqrt (P.quadDiscrim φ x)

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsField.Potential.quadDiscrim_eq_zero_iff
entries.snippet:
lemma quadDiscrim_eq_zero_iff (h : P.𝓵 ≠ 0) (φ : HiggsField) (x : SpaceTime) :
    P.quadDiscrim φ x = 0 ↔ P.toFun φ x = - P.μ2 ^ 2 / (4 * P.𝓵)

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsField.Potential.quadDiscrim_eq_zero_iff_normSq
entries.snippet:
lemma quadDiscrim_eq_zero_iff_normSq (h : P.𝓵 ≠ 0) (φ : HiggsField) (x : SpaceTime) :
    P.quadDiscrim φ x = 0 ↔ ‖φ‖_H ^ 2 x = P.μ2 / (2 * P.𝓵)

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsField.Potential.neg_𝓵_quadDiscrim_zero_bound
entries.snippet:
lemma neg_𝓵_quadDiscrim_zero_bound (h : P.𝓵 < 0) (φ : HiggsField) (x : SpaceTime) :
    P.toFun φ x ≤ - P.μ2 ^ 2 / (4 * P.𝓵)

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsField.Potential.pos_𝓵_quadDiscrim_zero_bound
entries.snippet:
lemma pos_𝓵_quadDiscrim_zero_bound (h : 0 < P.𝓵) (φ : HiggsField) (x : SpaceTime) :
    - P.μ2 ^ 2 / (4 * P.𝓵) ≤ P.toFun φ x

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsField.Potential.neg_𝓵_toFun_neg
entries.snippet:
lemma neg_𝓵_toFun_neg (h : P.𝓵 < 0) (φ : HiggsField) (x : SpaceTime) :
    (0 < P.μ2 ∧ P.toFun φ x ≤ 0) ∨ P.μ2 ≤ 0

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsField.Potential.pos_𝓵_toFun_pos
entries.snippet:
lemma pos_𝓵_toFun_pos (h : 0 < P.𝓵) (φ : HiggsField) (x : SpaceTime) :
    (P.μ2 < 0 ∧ 0 ≤ P.toFun φ x) ∨ 0 ≤ P.μ2

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsField.Potential.neg_𝓵_sol_exists_iff
entries.snippet:
lemma neg_𝓵_sol_exists_iff (h𝓵 : P.𝓵 < 0) (c : ℝ) : (∃ φ x, P.toFun φ x = c) ↔ (0 < P.μ2 ∧ c ≤ 0) ∨
    (P.μ2 ≤ 0 ∧ c ≤ - P.μ2 ^ 2 / (4 * P.𝓵))

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsField.Potential.pos_𝓵_sol_exists_iff
entries.snippet:
lemma pos_𝓵_sol_exists_iff (h𝓵 : 0 < P.𝓵) (c : ℝ) : (∃ φ x, P.toFun φ x = c) ↔ (P.μ2 < 0 ∧ 0 ≤ c) ∨
    (0 ≤ P.μ2 ∧ - P.μ2 ^ 2 / (4 * P.𝓵) ≤ c)

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsField.Potential.IsBounded
entries.docstring: The proposition on the coefficents for a potential to be bounded.
entries.snippet: def IsBounded : Prop

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsField.Potential.isBounded_𝓵_nonneg
entries.snippet:
lemma isBounded_𝓵_nonneg (h : P.IsBounded) :
    0 ≤ P.𝓵

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsField.Potential.isBounded_of_𝓵_pos
entries.snippet: lemma isBounded_of_𝓵_pos (h : 0 < P.𝓵) : P.IsBounded

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsField.Potential.isBounded_iff_of_𝓵_zero
entries.snippet:
informal_lemma isBounded_iff_of_𝓵_zero where
  physics :≈ "When there is no quartic coupling, the potential is bounded iff the mass squared is
    non-positive."
  math :≈ "For `P : Potential` then P.IsBounded if and only if P.μ2 ≤ 0.
    That is to say `- P.μ2 * ‖φ‖_H ^ 2 x` is bounded below if and only if `P.μ2 ≤ 0`."
  deps :≈ [`StandardModel.HiggsField.Potential.IsBounded, `StandardModel.HiggsField.Potential]

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsField.Potential.eq_zero_iff_of_μSq_nonpos_𝓵_pos
entries.snippet:
lemma eq_zero_iff_of_μSq_nonpos_𝓵_pos (h𝓵 : 0 < P.𝓵) (hμ2 : P.μ2 ≤ 0) (φ : HiggsField)
    (x : SpaceTime) : P.toFun φ x = 0 ↔ φ x = 0

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsField.Potential.isMinOn_iff_of_μSq_nonpos_𝓵_pos
entries.snippet:
lemma isMinOn_iff_of_μSq_nonpos_𝓵_pos (h𝓵 : 0 < P.𝓵) (hμ2 : P.μ2 ≤ 0) (φ : HiggsField)
    (x : SpaceTime) : IsMinOn (fun (φ, x) => P.toFun φ x) Set.univ (φ, x)
    ↔ P.toFun φ x = 0

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsField.Potential.isMinOn_iff_field_of_μSq_nonpos_𝓵_pos
entries.snippet:
lemma isMinOn_iff_field_of_μSq_nonpos_𝓵_pos (h𝓵 : 0 < P.𝓵) (hμ2 : P.μ2 ≤ 0) (φ : HiggsField)
    (x : SpaceTime) : IsMinOn (fun (φ, x) => P.toFun φ x) Set.univ (φ, x)
    ↔ φ x = 0

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsField.Potential.isMinOn_iff_of_μSq_nonneg_𝓵_pos
entries.snippet:
lemma isMinOn_iff_of_μSq_nonneg_𝓵_pos (h𝓵 : 0 < P.𝓵) (hμ2 : 0 ≤ P.μ2) (φ : HiggsField)
    (x : SpaceTime) : IsMinOn (fun (φ, x) => P.toFun φ x) Set.univ (φ, x) ↔
    P.toFun φ x = - P.μ2 ^ 2 / (4 * P.𝓵)

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsField.Potential.isMinOn_iff_field_of_μSq_nonneg_𝓵_pos
entries.snippet:
lemma isMinOn_iff_field_of_μSq_nonneg_𝓵_pos (h𝓵 : 0 < P.𝓵) (hμ2 : 0 ≤ P.μ2) (φ : HiggsField)
    (x : SpaceTime) : IsMinOn (fun (φ, x) => P.toFun φ x) Set.univ (φ, x) ↔
    ‖φ‖_H ^ 2 x = P.μ2 /(2 * P.𝓵)

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsField.Potential.isMinOn_iff_field_of_𝓵_pos
entries.snippet:
theorem isMinOn_iff_field_of_𝓵_pos (h𝓵 : 0 < P.𝓵) (φ : HiggsField) (x : SpaceTime) :
    IsMinOn (fun (φ, x) => P.toFun φ x) Set.univ (φ, x) ↔
    (0 ≤ P.μ2 ∧ ‖φ‖_H ^ 2 x = P.μ2 /(2 * P.𝓵)) ∨ (P.μ2 < 0 ∧ φ x = 0)

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsField.Potential.isMaxOn_iff_isMinOn_neg
entries.snippet:
lemma isMaxOn_iff_isMinOn_neg (φ : HiggsField) (x : SpaceTime) :
    IsMaxOn (fun (φ, x) => P.toFun φ x) Set.univ (φ, x) ↔
    IsMinOn (fun (φ, x) => P.neg.toFun φ x) Set.univ (φ, x)

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsField.Potential.isMaxOn_iff_field_of_𝓵_neg
entries.snippet:
lemma isMaxOn_iff_field_of_𝓵_neg (h𝓵 : P.𝓵 < 0) (φ : HiggsField) (x : SpaceTime) :
    IsMaxOn (fun (φ, x) => P.toFun φ x) Set.univ (φ, x) ↔
    (P.μ2 ≤ 0 ∧ ‖φ‖_H ^ 2 x = P.μ2 /(2 * P.𝓵)) ∨ (0 < P.μ2 ∧ φ x = 0)
